_about: NOLI deck (like Chance). Drawn on NOLI tiles 2, 11 and 25. Every card is a guess: the screenshots show no card text. Each card carries a Noli Me Tangere fact.

effects.moveTo: Move to tile 'target'. Collect the START salary if you pass START.
effects.goToExile: Go straight to Dapitan Exile. Do not pass START.
effects.freeFromExile: Keep this card. Use it to leave Dapitan Exile.

cards.text: Ibarra returns home from seven years in Europe. Advance to START.
cards.fact: Noli Me Tangere opens with a dinner party at Capitan Tiago's house welcoming Crisostomo Ibarra home from Europe.

cards.text: Padre Damaso insults you at Capitan Tiago's dinner. Pay ₱50.
cards.fact: At the welcome dinner, Padre Damaso rudely belittles Ibarra and the education he got abroad.

cards.text: Elias saves you from the falling derrick. Collect ₱100.
cards.fact: At the cornerstone ceremony for Ibarra's school, a rigged derrick collapses, and Elias pulls Ibarra to safety.

cards.text: Lay the cornerstone of your school. Go to Ibarra's School.
cards.fact: Ibarra plans to build a school in San Diego in memory of his father, Don Rafael.

cards.text: You are blamed for an uprising you did not plan. Go to Dapitan Exile.
cards.fact: Ibarra is framed for a staged attack on the barracks and is arrested.

cards.text: Elias rows you to safety on the lake. Keep this card to leave Dapitan Exile.
cards.fact: Elias helps Ibarra escape by hiding him in his banca on the Pasig and the lake.

cards.text: Sisa searches for her sons. Move back 3 tiles.
cards.fact: Sisa loses her mind searching for her sons Basilio and Crispin, one of the novel's saddest stories.

cards.text: The town fiesta of San Diego. Collect ₱20 from every player.
cards.fact: Several chapters of the Noli describe the lavish fiesta of San Diego.

cards.text: Visit the fictional town of the Noli. Go to Noli: San Diego.
cards.fact: San Diego, Ibarra's hometown, is a fictional town by a lake, often linked to Calamba.

cards.text: Pilosopo Tasio writes for the future. Collect ₱50.
cards.fact: The old scholar Tasio writes in hieroglyphics, hoping future generations will read what he means.

cards.text: Capitan Tiago throws a party. Pay each player ₱10.
cards.fact: Capitan Tiago, Maria Clara's father, is a rich man who keeps on good terms with the friars and officials.

cards.text: Your novel is printed with Maximo Viola's help. Go to Berlin.
cards.fact: Rizal printed 2,000 copies of Noli Me Tangere in Berlin in 1887 using a loan from Maximo Viola.
